_about: The clinic's words and sentence frames for the language seam (js/core/lang through the clinic's source, js/clinic/lang.js). R5 moved every Kutchi word, number table and join (pela / ne poi / ne, wadho / nindho) out of the clinic's code into this file. Nothing here is new Kutchi: words that Cook already has keep Cook's id and entry (from: data/cook.json), the rest were string literals in js/clinic and say where. A word with kutchi: null is an English placeholder (grey italic, flagged to record). Describing words and 'one' agree with the noun's gender; a noun of unknown gender takes the he-form, flagged 'to check' (decision 21). The frames here have no full stop (card rows: F10).
